$operator.summary: Environment-independent provider:tier aliases with local executor choices for supported hosts.
$operator.note: Keep executor-specific model strings in the untracked config_overrides.json under model_config or a local persona override. After changing either file, run ./bin/pan models --sync. New runs snapshot the resolved mapping; existing runs keep their snapshot. VS Code workers may use Copilot while the supervisor stays in the operator session. Use cursor: or cursor-cli: mappings when those executors are needed.

balanced.summary: Focused coding, strong review, and frontier planning.

advanced.summary: Stronger coding and QA for complex work.

auto.summary: Cursor-managed routing except for the bounded coding workhorse.

$operator.summary: Named profiles controlling how heavily the operator gates each workflow stage. Select one per run with ./bin/pan init --involvement <profile>; omitting the flag uses active.
$operator.note: gates maps a stage slug (or * for every stage) to the gate that stage uses for the run. contracts names run-wide contracts the run abides by. Runs snapshot the resolved profile, so later edits here do not change an in-flight run. Inspect available profiles with ./bin/pan involvement.

standard.summary: Workflow-declared gates, unchanged. The operator ratifies the plan and approves release preparation.

hands-off.summary: Minimum interruption. The supervisor ratifies the plan instead of the operator; release preparation still stops for explicit operator approval.

technical-director.summary: The operator refines the technical plan with its author before implementation and responds to the independent review before the run continues.

high-touch.summary: Every stage stops for explicit operator approval, and the technical-director refinement contract is active.

long-horizon.summary: Runs independently between preflight and post-run with bounded away-mode decisions; release preparation and every correctness boundary remain unchanged. waive-gate is allowed so a cost- or wall-time-backed criterion never stops a task; the supervisor decides and records every away-mode action.

$operator.summary: Named verification levels controlling which repository-check profile each shell gate runs. Select one per run with ./bin/pan init --verification <level>; omitting the flag uses active.
$operator.note: Built-in levels: minimal (static and fast gate the implement and remediate loops; no gate runs full, including the ship release gate), light (static and fast gate the implement and remediate loops; the full profile runs only as the ship release gate when the run enters ship, a failure routes to remediate and returns to ship, at most twice before the operator decides), thorough (alias of light kept for existing snapshots). No verify or remediate gate runs full. Agents iterate on the impacted profile plus their added tests. Implementing agents leave fast to the gates, evidence workers run the fast profile once each at most as final validation, and agents never run full. The full profile is never baselined before implementation. Operator-declared levels here merge over the built-ins. Runs snapshot the resolved level. Change an in-flight run with ./bin/pan verification <run-id> set <level>. Inspect levels with ./bin/pan verification.
